title: The Siren After Lights Out
victim: Ryota Kise, Kaijo's ace from the Generation of Miracles
teaser: Summer training camp by the sea: several school teams are staying at one ryokan and training in the gym next door. At 01:15 everyone was woken by the scoreboard siren. Under the hoop lay Ryota Kise, Kaijo's ace from the Generation of Miracles and a cover model. He could copy any move after seeing it once. The scoreboard showed 0:7, and Kise wears number seven. The bus to town won't come until morning.

habits.label: Drinks vanilla shakes
habits.habit: Can't get through a day without a vanilla shake from the burger joint
clues: Under the bench there's a burger joint cup with the dregs of a vanilla shake, and the ice in it hasn't melted yet. The culprit drinks vanilla shakes.
The ball by the body has a sticky patch that smells of vanilla. The culprit drinks vanilla shakes.

habits.label: Horoscope lucky charm
habits.habit: Listens to the horoscope every morning and carries the lucky item all day
clues: A plush frog was left by the hoop. The morning horoscope named it the lucky item for Cancer. The culprit carries a horoscope lucky charm.
A printout of today's horoscope lies in the equipment store, with one sign circled in pen. The culprit carries a horoscope lucky charm.

habits.label: Munches corn puffs
habits.habit: Always has a bag of sweet corn puffs in hand
clues: Crumbs of sweet corn puffs are scattered along the free-throw line. The culprit munches corn puffs.
The changing room bin has five empty bags of corn puffs, and the bin was emptied in the evening. The culprit munches corn puffs.

habits.label: Wears wristbands
habits.habit: Doesn't take off their towelling wristbands even at dinner
clues: A towelling wristband lies on the parquet by the hoop. The culprit wears wristbands.
The back of the bench has towelling fluff on it, as if someone rubbed a wrist against it. The culprit wears wristbands.

habits.label: Idol magazine
habits.habit: Carries a magazine of idol photos everywhere
clues: A rolled-up magazine with a pop singer on the cover was left under the bench. The culprit reads idol magazines.
A spread with an idol's photo, torn out of a magazine, lies on the changing room floor. The culprit reads idol magazines.

habits.label: Squeaky trainers
habits.habit: Wears new trainers that squeak at every step
clues: The ryokan cook heard rapid squeaking of soles from the gym well after midnight. The culprit wears squeaky trainers.
Black streaks from a new sole run across the parquet from the door to the hoop. The culprit wears squeaky trainers.

habits.label: Runs on the sand
habits.habit: Runs on the beach before dawn and has sand everywhere
clues: A trail of sand runs from the gym's back door to the hoop. The culprit runs on the beach.
Wet sand is packed into the gap under the changing room door, though the floor there was mopped in the evening. The culprit runs on the beach.

habits.label: Carries their own ball
habits.habit: Carries a worn, autographed ball everywhere
clues: The ball by the body isn't one from the gym's basket but someone's own, covered in autographs. The culprit carries their own ball.
There's a round print of a dirty ball on the parquet under the bench, and the gym balls were wiped down in the evening. The culprit carries their own ball.

habits.label: Plays shogi
habits.habit: Carries a travel shogi set and plays against themselves
clues: A shogi piece, the king, lies at Kise's feet. The culprit plays shogi.
A travel board with an unfinished game stands on the bench. The culprit plays shogi.

habits.label: Plays with the puppy
habits.habit: Feeds the team's puppy, and it follows them everywhere
clues: The parquet by the body has small dog paw prints. The culprit plays with the puppy.
Kise's T-shirt has black and white dog hair on it, and he never goes near the puppy. The culprit plays with the puppy.

habits.label: Honey lemons
habits.habit: Carries a jar of lemon slices in honey everywhere
clues: A honeyed lemon slice lies by the body. The culprit carries honey lemons around.
The bench has a sticky ring from a jar that smells of honey and lemon. The culprit carries honey lemons around.

habits.label: Makes up puns
habits.habit: Showers everyone with puns and writes the good ones on napkins
clues: A napkin under the bench has a pun on it: "Night pass, no fuss." The culprit makes up puns.
A fresh pun is chalked on the coaches' tactics board, and the board was wiped after the evening review. The culprit makes up puns.

habits.label: Wears a yukata
habits.habit: Only ever wears the inn's yukata around the ryokan
clues: A yukata sash with the ryokan's pattern hangs on a hook by the gym door. The culprit wears a yukata.
The landlady saw a blue yukata flash past the gym window. The culprit wears a yukata.

habits.label: Smells of chlorine
habits.habit: Swims in the pool every evening and smells of chlorine
clues: Drops are drying on the parquet by the hoop, and they smell of chlorine. The culprit smells of chlorine.
Kise's windbreaker smells of chlorine, though he didn't go to the pool that day. The culprit smells of chlorine.

habits.label: Clicks a hand gripper
clues: A hand gripper was left by the bench. The culprit trains their grip with a hand gripper.
The night watchman heard a spring clicking steadily in the gym. The culprit trains their grip with a hand gripper.

habits.label: Wears a knee brace
habits.habit: Never takes off a knee brace after an old injury
clues: A torn Velcro strap from a knee brace was left on the bench. The culprit wears a knee brace.
The ryokan cook was taking out the rubbish and heard Velcro rip in the gym. The culprit wears a knee brace.

strong: The mobile hoop stand was rolled over to the beach exit to block the door. It normally takes three people to move. The culprit is physically strong.
The heavy landing mat was dragged across the whole gym and laid over Kise. It takes four to carry. The culprit is physically strong.
quiet: The night watchman never left the entrance and swears only Kise went into the gym after lights out. Someone walked right under his nose. The culprit knows how to go unnoticed.
The ryokan has old floorboards, and after lights out every step can be heard. That night nobody walked to the gym, yet the killer got there. The culprit knows how to go unnoticed.
tools: The equipment store lock isn't broken: it was taken apart with a screwdriver and put back together. The culprit is good at fixing things.
A leg of the bench was unscrewed and put back so that the bench collapsed the moment Kise sat down. The culprit is good at fixing things.
medic: Kise's ankle was taped so tightly that his foot went numb and he couldn't have run. Only someone trained to tape does it like that. The culprit knows sports medicine.
All the ice packs are gone from the team first-aid kit, and they were packed round Kise's body so nobody could tell when he died. The culprit knows sports medicine.
keys: The landlady locked the gym at ten in the evening, and not a scratch appeared on the door overnight. The culprit had their own key.
The scoreboard remote is kept in a locked drawer of the officials' table. The drawer was opened without a single scratch. The culprit had a key.
safe: Kise's locker in the changing room has a combination lock. The lock is intact, yet Kaijo's number 7 kit is missing from the locker. The culprit knows the lock combinations.
Kise's phone turned up in the coaches' combination safe where phones are handed in after lights out, though he didn't hand his in that evening. The culprit knows the lock combinations.
sched: The siren went off when the coaches had already finished their night round and gone to the bath house. The culprit knows the camp routine.
Every night after lights out Kise came to the empty gym to practise the moves he'd copied, and few people knew it. The culprit knows the camp routine.
tech: The siren wasn't set off from the remote: it was put on a timer and went off by itself at 01:15, long after the killer had left. The culprit knows electronics.
The camera the manager used to film the evening practice is still on its tripod, but every recording was deleted on the camera itself. The culprit knows electronics.
cash: Next to Kise there's a box of new trainers costing forty thousand yen and a note: "Forget what you saw." Someone tried to buy him. The culprit has money.
The landlady was paid in cash to hire the gym for the whole night, though the coaches booked nothing. The culprit has money.
passages: A service corridor runs from the bath house to the gym, used only by ryokan staff. There are fresh wet footprints on its floor. The culprit knows the way round.
The equipment store window opens straight onto the beach and doesn't lock. Only people who've been to this camp before know about it. The culprit knows the way round.
